tagline: Find songs sung in VTuber karaoke streams — jump straight to the timestamp.
home_headline: Find the song. Catch the moment.
home_intro: Search thousands of setlist entries and jump straight to the exact performance — no scrubbing, no guesswork.
home_library_fallback: The library updates automatically as new karaoke streams are analyzed.
home_explore_hint: Browse the performers currently in the index.
search_hint: Type at least one character. Optional filters narrow by channel, stream type, or date. Results open YouTube at the setlist timestamp.
empty_prompt: Search for a title to see karaoke setlist hits.
empty_results: No songs matched “{query}”. Try another spelling.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Check that the API is running.
channels_hint: Explore karaoke archives and song uploads by performer.
channels_empty: No channels yet. Add a YouTube channel URL to start tracking.
channel_add_hint: Paste a YouTube channel URL. Metadata is scraped once; the enabled updater starts filling videos immediately.
videos_empty: No videos for this channel yet.
karaoke_empty: No karaoke streams for this channel yet.
karaoke_empty_with_setlist: No karaoke streams with a setlist for this channel.
karaoke_empty_without_setlist: No karaoke streams without a setlist for this channel.
song_videos_empty: No song videos for this channel yet.
video_setlist_hint: Select a timestamp to start listening from that exact moment.
songs_empty: No songs extracted for this stream yet.
video_song_no_setlist: This is a standalone song upload — no setlist comments to show.
reload_hint: Refreshes recent Streams + Videos metadata while preserving existing videos and setlists.
song_reload_hint: Admin only: re-fetches top comments and runs the setlist analyzer again.
song_not_found: That song id is invalid or no longer exists.
auth_login_hint: Search and browsing are public. Channel, scraper, and updater controls require the administrator account.
auth_invalid: The username or password is incorrect.
auth_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth_not_configured: Administrator authentication has not been configured on this server.
status_hint: Live view of the background scraper and setlist analyzer. Refreshes every few seconds.
summary_hint: Database-backed totals for scraped records, comment analysis, extracted setlists, and backfill progress.
summary_pipeline_hint: Coverage is measured against stored karaoke streams.
summary_backfill_hint: Full Streams + Videos history ingestion by channel.
info_contact_body: For service questions, privacy requests, or corrections, contact the operator through the public repository.
about_intro: Setlist is a searchable index of songs performed in VTuber karaoke streams. It helps listeners find a performance and jump to its timestamp on YouTube.
about_how_body: A background service discovers public channel archives, inspects top comments for timestamped setlists, and extracts song titles. Automated results can be incomplete or incorrect, so the original YouTube page remains the authoritative source.
about_scope_body: This service is independently operated and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by YouTube, Google, any VTuber agency, channel, or performer.
about_source_body: The application source and technical documentation are public. Deployment credentials, administrator password hashes, signing keys, and other runtime secrets are intentionally excluded.
terms_intro: By using this deployment of Setlist, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms_use_body: You may search and browse the public index for personal and informational purposes. Do not overload the service, bypass rate limits or access controls, probe for secrets, interfere with operation, or use automated traffic that harms availability.
terms_accuracy_body: Song titles, timestamps, classifications, dates, and channel information are created from automated processing and public third-party data. They may be delayed, incomplete, or wrong. The service is provided as-is without warranties.
terms_external_body: Results link to YouTube and may display remotely hosted channel images. Your use of those services is governed by their own terms and privacy practices. Setlist does not control external content or availability.
terms_availability_body: The operator may change, suspend, limit, or discontinue the service at any time. To the extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for losses arising from use of, or inability to use, this service.
terms_changes_body: These terms may be updated as the service develops. The date shown above identifies the current version. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
privacy_intro: Setlist does not offer public user accounts, advertising, or built-in analytics. Like most self-hosted web services, it still processes limited technical data needed for delivery, security, and preferences.
privacy_collected_body: The server receives network information such as IP address, request path, time, and user-agent through normal HTTP and reverse-proxy logs. Search terms are sent to the API. IP addresses are held temporarily in memory to enforce guest rate limits.
privacy_storage_body: The browser stores language, theme, and recent-search preferences locally. These preferences stay on the device unless you clear browser data. The service does not use third-party advertising or analytics cookies.
privacy_admin_body: Only the service administrator can sign in. A Secure, HttpOnly session cookie is used for protected management features and expires automatically. Guest browsing does not create an account or administrator session.
privacy_external_body: Opening a result sends you to YouTube. Channel thumbnails may load from YouTube or Google infrastructure, which can receive your IP address and browser information under their own privacy policies.
privacy_retention_body: Temporary rate-limit records expire automatically. Access-log retention depends on the deployment operator and reverse-proxy configuration. Reasonable safeguards are used, but no internet service can guarantee absolute security.
copyright_intro: Setlist is an index and search tool. It does not host karaoke audio or video and does not claim ownership of linked performances.
copyright_media_body: Videos, audio, thumbnails, channel names, and related creative material remain the property of their respective owners. Playback occurs on YouTube under the uploader's and platform's terms.
copyright_metadata_body: The service stores factual metadata, public URLs, timestamps, and automatically extracted song-title text to help locate public performances. A listing does not imply endorsement or transfer of rights.
copyright_source_body: The application source is available under the MIT License. Third-party packages, fonts, linked media, service APIs, and extracted metadata remain subject to their own licenses and terms.
copyright_request_body: Rights holders and channel operators may request a correction, channel exclusion, or removal. Include the affected URL, what should change, and enough information to verify the request. Do not post private documents in a public issue.
